title: Case Fixer
desc: Caps Lock accidents and fat-finger typos. Fix the case and swap the letters back.

levels.title: Stop shouting
levels.tip: Alt+L lowercases from the cursor to the end of the word, then leaves the cursor there.

levels.title: Environment
levels.tip: Alt+U uppercases to the end of the word. Words stop at punctuation, so '=' is safe.

levels.title: Caps Lock was on
levels.tip: Each press handles one word and moves past it, so just keep pressing.

levels.title: Proper message
levels.tip: Alt+C capitalizes: first letter up, the rest down. Hop back to the word first.

levels.title: Inverted
levels.tip: Mix and match: each word needs a different fix.

levels.title: Steam locomotive
levels.tip: Ctrl+T swaps the two characters before the cursor when you're at the end of the line.

levels.title: Classic typo
levels.tip: In the middle of a line, Ctrl+T swaps the character before the cursor with the one under it.

levels.title: Stauts
levels.tip: Get the cursor between the two swapped letters, then Ctrl+T.

levels.title: Backwards
levels.tip: Alt+T swaps the two words around the cursor. At the end of the line it swaps the last two.

levels.title: Remote first
levels.tip: Put the cursor between the two words (or after them) and Alt+T.

levels.title: Bad day
levels.tip: Everything at once. Alt+T moves the cursor too, so plan the order.
